references.text: Israel repeats the same request to Sihon, king of the Amorites, to pass through his land by the King's Highway without turning to the right or to the left.
Moses reminds the people that they were to buy food and water from Edom, showing that they would take nothing without payment.
Moses sends a message to Sihon with the same promise to stay on the King's Highway and pay for food and water.
Israel repeats the promise to follow the main road and pay for any water they drink.
The command not to turn to the right or to the left is used as an image of following the Lord's way exactly.
The expression 'do not turn to the right or to the left' is used about following the law's requirements precisely.
The same expression is used about not turning aside from the Lord's commands to the right or to the left.
Jephthah refers to this event when Israel asked for permission to pass through Edom's land but was refused.
